districts.name: Kubwa
districts.vibe: Affordable, far, full of hustlers and Lapo Babies. A long commute down the Kubwa Expressway.

districts.name: Dei-Dei
districts.vibe: Building materials market, trailers, dust and deals. Everybody knows somebody.

districts.name: Lugbe
districts.vibe: Airport Road: estates half-built, factories, okadas and the smell of fresh cement.

districts.name: Gwarinpa
districts.vibe: Africa's biggest housing estate: duplexes, avenues and a supermarket on every corner.

districts.name: Jabi Lake & Malls
districts.vibe: The lake, the mall, Saturday boat rides and Instagram brunch.

districts.name: Wuye
districts.vibe: Quiet streets, small businesses and civil servants who leave home at 6.

districts.name: Lokogoma
districts.vibe: New estates on the city edge: cheaper rent, unfinished roads.

districts.name: Katampe Extension
districts.vibe: Hilltop mansions with city views, built behind tall walls.

gate.message: Estate security is watching you: "Oga, who you come see?" Stay too long and you'll be stopped. (Welcome at Reputation 45 or with Bolaji as a friend.)

districts.name: Maitama
districts.vibe: Old money, new money, embassy money. Gates within gates.

gate.message: Estate security is watching you: "Oga, who you come see?" Stay too long and you'll be stopped. (Welcome at Reputation 45 or with Bolaji as a friend.)

districts.name: Utako
districts.vibe: Bus parks, banks and the busiest market traffic in town.

districts.name: Mpape
districts.vibe: A crowded hillside settlement looking down on Maitama.

districts.name: Wuse
districts.vibe: Wuse Market and Wuse II: noise, deals and nightlife.

districts.name: Central Business District
districts.vibe: Ministries, banks, towers and the National Mosque.

districts.name: Garki
districts.vibe: Area 1 to Area 11: offices, hospitals, the motor park and the old city heart.

districts.name: Apo
districts.vibe: Mechanic village, resettlement and a long road to everywhere.

districts.name: Three Arms Zone & Aso Rock
districts.vibe: The Villa, the National Assembly and the Supreme Court, under the shadow of Aso Rock.

gate.message: Soldiers at the Three Arms Zone checkpoint: "No access. Turn back now." (Needs very high Reputation or an official pass.)

districts.name: Asokoro
districts.vibe: Where the powerful sleep, behind mobile police and roundabouts.

gate.message: Mobile police at the roundabout look you over. Hang around too long and they'll stop you. (Welcome at Reputation 70 or Network 80.)

districts.name: Guzape
districts.vibe: New mansions on the hills: the money that came after.

gate.message: Mobile police at the roundabout look you over. Hang around too long and they'll stop you. (Welcome at Reputation 70 or Network 80.)

districts.name: Karu
districts.vibe: Across the border in Nasarawa: cheap rent, packed buses into the city.

districts.name: Nyanya
districts.vibe: Crowded, lively, rough round the edges. Home for many who work in the city.

places.name: Your room (Nyanya)
places.blurb: One room, one window, one landlord who knocks on Saturdays.

actions.label: Rest
actions.text: You lie down. The neighbour's generator sings you a lullaby.

actions.label: Cook garri and beans (₦800)
actions.text: Garri, beans and a little palm oil. Not fancy, but your stomach is quiet now.

actions.label: 🍳 Go to your kitchen
actions.text: Cook from recipes, experiment, manage your pantry and garden.

actions.label: Buy pure water sachets (₦200)
actions.text: Two cold sachets from the kiosk outside. You bite the corner like a pro.

actions.label: Wash your clothes by hand
actions.text: Bucket, bar soap, and a lot of scrubbing. Your clothes are clean and on the line.

actions.label: Study
actions.text: You read until NEPA takes light. Then you read by phone torch.
actions.lockedText: No light: AEDC cut you off. Pay the electricity bill in the Bills app.

actions.label: Learn tech online (₦1,500 data)
actions.text: Free course, paid data. You fix your first bug.
actions.lockedText: No light: AEDC cut you off. Pay the electricity bill in the Bills app.

actions.label: 🤝 Talk to Mrs. Bello about your rent

places.name: Your flat (Gwarinpa)
places.blurb: A self-contain in Gwarinpa. Water runs on Tuesdays and Fridays.

actions.label: Rest
actions.text: You rest. Your mother calls to ask if you have eaten.

actions.label: Cook rice and stew (₦1,800)
actions.text: A proper pot of rice and stew. You'll eat it again tomorrow.

actions.label: 🍳 Go to your kitchen
actions.text: Cook from recipes, experiment, manage your pantry and garden.

actions.label: Drink water from the dispenser
actions.text: Cold water from the dispenser. Refreshing.

actions.label: Wash your clothes (washing machine)
actions.text: The machine hums while you scroll. Clean clothes, folded and ready.
actions.lockedText: No light: AEDC cut you off. Pay the electricity bill in the Bills app.

actions.label: Study
actions.text: A quiet afternoon with a book. Productive.
actions.lockedText: No light: AEDC cut you off. Pay the electricity bill in the Bills app.

actions.label: Learn tech online (₦1,500 data)
actions.text: You finish a module and feel unstoppable for ten minutes.
actions.lockedText: No light: AEDC cut you off. Pay the electricity bill in the Bills app.

places.name: Spotless Dry Cleaners (Gwarinpa)
places.blurb: Dry cleaning for people with meetings. Same day if you smile.

actions.label: Same-day wash and press (₦4,000)
actions.text: Crisp, pressed and smelling of fabric softener.

places.name: POS Junction
places.blurb: Umbrellas, plastic chairs, and a queue that never ends. Withdrawal charges: negotiable.

actions.label: Buy your own POS stand (₦150,000)

effects.log: Bought a POS stand in Nyanya.

actions.text: Umbrella, table, terminal, and a hand-painted sign. You are now a businessperson.

actions.label: Run your POS stand
actions.lockedText: You don't own a POS stand yet

else.toast: Network was down all day. A customer's transfer failed and you refunded him.

actions.text: You open shop under the umbrella.

actions.label: Buy pure water (₦100)
actions.text: A cold sachet from the woman beside the POS stand.

places.name: Mama Nkechi Laundry (Nyanya)
places.blurb: Wash, starch and iron. Mama Nkechi knows everybody's business and everybody's shirt size.

actions.label: Wash and iron everything (₦2,500)
actions.text: Mama Nkechi hands your clothes back clean, starched and folded. "Next time don't wait so long."

actions.label: Buy pure water (₦100)
actions.text: A sachet from Mama Nkechi's freezer.

places.name: Wuse Market
places.blurb: Everything, everywhere, all at once. Customers say 'last price' and mean 'first price'.

actions.label: Buy and resell goods (₦20,000)

else.toast: Slow day. You sold half and got back ₦14,000.

actions.text: You buy wholesale and hawk it through the market.

actions.label: Eat at a buka (₦1,500)
actions.text: Rice, beans, plantain and a piece of meat. Mama put serves with a smile.

actions.label: 🛒 Shop for ingredients
actions.text: Cheap and standard produce, meat, fish and provisions.

actions.label: Buy pure water (₦100)
actions.text: A cold sachet of pure water. Life.

actions.label: Pinch something from a stall

then.toast: Nobody saw. You sell it round the corner for ₦4,000. Your heart is still racing.

else.toast: "OLE! OLE!" The traders catch you. You're slapped around, made to pay ₦5,000 and dragged to the market chairman.

actions.text: You wait until the trader turns to argue with a customer…

actions.label: 🤝 Haggle with Iya Bose for fabric bales

places.name: Abuja Culinary Academy
places.blurb: Chef whites, steel benches and an instructor who has cooked in London. Professional and pastry classes.

actions.label: 👩‍🍳 Take a cooking class
actions.text: Learn professional recipes and technique.

places.name: QuickKash Microfinance
places.blurb: "Fast loans, no collateral, no wahala!" The wahala is in the small print.

actions.label: Talk to Mr. Felix about a loan
🤝 Negotiate a bigger loan with Mr. Felix

places.name: Wuse Tech Hub
places.blurb: Bean bags, fast Wi-Fi, and founders explaining their 'Uber for X'.

actions.label: Do a freelance design gig
actions.text: A logo for a 'premium' bukka. The client wants it 'more premium'. Paid anyway.

actions.label: Attend a tech meetup
actions.text: Free small chops and three founders who want you to work for equity.

actions.label: Coffee and a sandwich at the café (₦3,500)
actions.text: An overpriced latte and a sandwich. You feel like a startup founder.

places.name: Mrs. Okafor's consultancy
places.blurb: Plain office, serious woman, open door for people who show up.

actions.label: Visit Mrs. Okafor
actions.text: She asks about your plans, then asks about your plan B. Then your plan C.

places.name: Wuse Business Plaza
places.blurb: Six floors of offices: accountants, HR firms, and a lift that works on Mondays.

actions.label: Work a shift as admin assistant
Work a shift as hr officer

places.name: Garki Delivery Hub
places.blurb: Bikes, boxes, and riders who know every shortcut in Abuja.

actions.label: Take a quick driving lesson (₦5,000)
actions.text: The instructor screams 'BRAKE!' at every roundabout. You improve anyway.

places.name: CAC Registry & Business Centre (Garki)
places.blurb: Where business names are registered and dreams are stamped. Bring two passport photographs.

actions.label: Register your business name with CAC (₦25,000)

effects.log: Registered a business name with CAC.

actions.text: Forms, stamps and a long queue. You walk out with a CAC certificate. You are officially a CEO.

actions.label: 🤝 Negotiate: buy Chief Adebayo's logistics company
🤝 Negotiate: sell a business to Chief Adebayo

places.name: Garki General Hospital
places.blurb: Long benches, a generator that never stops, and doctors who have seen everything. Treatment first, bill after.

actions.label: General check-up and treatment (₦15,000)
actions.text: Drip, tablets, and a lecture about stress. You feel better.

actions.label: See a doctor about an injury
🤝 Negotiate your bill with the accountant

places.name: Area 1 Motor Park
places.blurb: Buses to everywhere. Loaders, hawkers, touts. Work for anyone who shows up early.

actions.label: Do daily labour (loading)
actions.text: You load bags of rice onto a Jos-bound bus. Your back files a complaint.

actions.label: Drive for Zoom (car rental ₦6,000)
actions.lockedText: Needs Driving 20 and a driver's licence (Safe Wheels Driving School)

actions.label: Drive for OwnPrice: passengers haggle (₦6,000)
actions.lockedText: Needs Driving 20 and a driver's licence (Safe Wheels Driving School)

actions.label: Buy roasted corn and pure water (₦500)
actions.text: Roasted corn and a sachet of water while the touts shout destinations.

places.name: Safe Wheels Driving School (Garki)
places.blurb: Learner cars with two brake pedals and instructors with nerves of steel. Pass here, then the FRSC test, and you get your driver's licence.

actions.label: Driving lesson (₦8,000)
actions.text: Mirror, signal, manoeuvre. The instructor only grabs the wheel twice.

places.name: Union Capital Bank HQ
places.blurb: Fictional bank, very real dress code. Your shoes must shine.

actions.label: Sort out a frozen account (BVN, statements)

places.name: Zenith Heights Tower
places.blurb: Twenty floors of glass. Corporate jobs that need degrees, NYSC and someone who knows someone.

places.name: Federal Ministry of Contracts
places.blurb: Fictional ministry. Contracts go to whoever's file 'moves'. Files move when people move them.

actions.label: Work a shift as civil servant

places.name: Visa & Travel Consultants
places.blurb: Posters of Canada, the UK and Germany. Proof of funds required. Hope sold separately.

actions.label: Japa: leave the country (needs ₦6,000,000 and a degree)

places.name: MTM Telecom office
places.blurb: Yellow everything. Call centres upstairs, engineers in the basement, and free data for staff.

actions.label: Work a shift as customer care rep
Work a shift as sales executive
Work a shift as network engineer

places.name: Jabi Lake Mall
places.blurb: Lake views, overpriced shawarma, and twenty people filming content at once.

actions.label: Flex: designer fit + photos (₦50,000)
actions.text: New fit, new pictures, new you. For about a week.

actions.label: Hang out and network (₦10,000)
actions.text: Small chops, big gist. Someone's cousin works at a bank.

actions.label: 🛒 Shoprite: groceries, kitchenware and cookbooks
actions.text: Premium and imported food, kitchen equipment and the bookshop.

actions.label: Shoot content by the lake

then.toast: Your video went viral! A brand slid into your DMs: +₦40,000.

then.log: Had a viral video at Jabi Lake.

actions.text: You film a skit about Abuja landlords. The geese photobomb it.

actions.label: Eat at a restaurant (₦9,000)
actions.text: Air conditioning, a real menu and a waiter who calls you 'boss'.

actions.label: Slip something into your bag

then.toast: The alarm doesn't go off. You sell the perfume for ₦12,000 and feel sick about it.

else.toast: The security man stops you at the door. CCTV, a long talk, a ₦20,000 'fine' and your face on the mall's WhatsApp group.

else.log: Caught shoplifting at Jabi Lake Mall.

actions.text: The perfume section has no attendant…

places.name: EFCC Headquarters (Jabi)
places.blurb: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission. Fraudsters, money launderers and corrupt officials all end up here eventually.

actions.label: Ask if there's a case against you

places.name: Tunde's place (Kubwa)
places.blurb: Tunde's one-room in Kubwa, always open, always something on the stove.

actions.label: Visit Tunde
actions.text: Pepper soup, old jokes, and new plans. Tunde is still Tunde.

actions.label: Go into business with Tunde (₦100,000)

effects.log: Started a logistics business with Tunde.

actions.text: Two bikes, one WhatsApp business line, and a friendship older than both of you. 'Tunde & {name} Logistics' is born.

actions.label: Work on the business with Tunde
actions.lockedText: You haven't started a business with Tunde
actions.text: You and Tunde sort the orders and send out the riders.

actions.label: Expand: buy five more bikes (₦600,000)

effects.log: Expanded the logistics business to a fleet of seven bikes.

actions.text: Five new bikes, five new riders, one proper office in Kubwa. Tunde cries small. You pretend you didn't see.

actions.label: Manage the fleet

else.toast: A rider crashed. Hospital and repairs: ₦20,000.

actions.text: You dispatch riders across Abuja from the Kubwa office.

places.name: Kubwa Village Market
places.blurb: Cheaper than Wuse. If you can buy here and sell there, you have a business.

actions.label: Buy foodstuff in bulk to resell (₦30,000)

else.toast: The tomatoes went soft. You got back ₦24,000.

actions.text: Bags of rice and beans, one borrowed van, and a prayer.

actions.label: 🛒 Shop for farm produce
actions.text: The cheapest local produce in Abuja, straight from the farms.

actions.label: Eat roasted plantain and fish (₦1,000)
actions.text: Boli and fish, hot from the grill.

actions.label: Buy pure water (₦100)
actions.text: A cold sachet of pure water.

actions.label: 🤝 Negotiate a supplier deal with Alhaji Sani

places.name: Slim's 'office' (Lugbe)
places.blurb: Blackout curtains, three ring lights, a PS5, and a lot of 'clients' abroad.

actions.label: Gist with Slim
actions.text: Slim orders suya for everybody. "My guy, when you ready, the format dey."

actions.label: Run 'the format' (fraud)
actions.lockedText: Slim doesn't trust you with 'the format' yet

then.toast: A 'client' paid. +₦350,000. Your hands are shaking.

actions.text: You open the laptop. The ring light comes on.

actions.label: Tell Slim you're out

effects.log: Walked away from fraud before it was too late.

actions.text: Slim stares. "You go come back." You don't.

places.name: Berger Tokunbo Car Mart (Lugbe)
places.blurb: Rows of 'first body' Tokunbo cars and a dealer who swears every one was used by a grandmother in Toronto.

actions.label: Rent a Toyota Camry for 3 days (₦30,000)

places.name: Bolaji's mansion
places.blurb: Fountain, three gatemen, and a garage bigger than your childhood home.

actions.label: Hang out with Bolaji (₦30,000 to keep up)
actions.text: Bolaji's friends talk about 'Dad's people' and 'small money' (₦5 million). You laugh at the right times.

actions.label: Ask Bolaji for a connect

effects.log: Asked a Nepo Baby for a connect. He made one phone call.

actions.text: Bolaji makes one phone call. "My guy, go to the Ministry. They're expecting you." It took him eight seconds.

places.name: Delta Crest Oil & Gas
places.blurb: Fictional oil company. Salaries in dollars, interviews by referral only.

places.name: Asokoro Owambe Hall
places.blurb: Every weekend, someone's daughter marries someone's son. Everyone important attends.

actions.label: Attend in aso-ebi (₦80,000)
actions.text: Jollof, small chops, and one business card from a man whose title is 'Chief'.
